📊 GitHub Copilot – Unified Reference Guide

🔧 FILTERS & SLICERS (HOW TO EXPLORE THE DATA)
🔧
Page-Level Slicers
Filters — affect ALL visuals on the page
Note: These controls let you narrow down every chart and number on the page at once. For example, selecting "vscode" in the IDE filter will update all charts to show only VS Code users.
SlicerFieldWhat it filters
TeamDimSeat[teamName]Filters all metrics to a specific GitHub team. Uses the Many-to-Many relationship between users and their team memberships.
IDEvGitHub_MetricUsers[IDE]Filters by coding editor (e.g. vscode, visualstudio, intellij).
LanguagevGitHub_MetricUsers[Language_Main]Filters by the primary programming language used in a session.
Date RangevGitHub_MetricUsers[FilterDate]Limits data to a specific date window.
📌 Metric Cards (top summary numbers)
👤
Total Users
Card Visual
Note: The total number of unique GitHub users who appear in the Copilot data for the selected period. Each person is counted once, no matter how many days or sessions they had.
Total Users
DISTINCTCOUNT('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[UserLogin])
✅
Active Users
Card Visual
Note: Users who have been actively using Copilot within the last 90 days from today. This is the standard GitHub definition of an "active seat" — if someone hasn't used Copilot in over 3 months, they don't count.
Active Seats
VAR CutoffDate = TODAY() - 90 RETURN COUNTROWS( FILTER( VALUES('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[UserLogin]), NOT ISBLANK('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[UserLogin]) && CALCULATE( MAXX( 'vGitHub_MetricUsers', DATEVALUE(LEFT('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[LastActivityAt], 10)) ) ) >= CutoffDate ) )
⚠️ For each user, this checks their most recent activity date. If it's within 90 days of today, they count as active. The 90-day window is always relative to today's date.
📈
Adoption Rate
Card Visual
Note: Out of all users who have a Copilot licence, what percentage are actually using it actively? A high adoption rate means people are regularly using Copilot, not just holding a licence.
Adoption Rate
DIVIDE([Active Seats], [Total Users])
⚠️ Formula: Active Seats ÷ Total Users. For example: 19,527 active ÷ 19,586 total = 99.7%.
📊 Line / Area Charts
📊
Acceptance Rate
Area Line Chart – over time
Note: Two lines showing how often users accept Copilot's suggestions over time.

Acceptance Rate (%) — of all code suggestions shown, what % did users keep? (overall)
Acceptance Lines Rate (%) — of all inline completion suggestions specifically, what % were accepted?
AxisField / Measure
X-axis (date)vGitHub_MetricUsers[FilterDate]
Y-axis series 1Acceptance Rate (%)
Y-axis series 2Acceptance Lines Rate (%)
Acceptance Rate (%)
DIVIDE( [Total Acceptances], [Total Suggestions], 0 )
Acceptance Lines Rate (%)
DIVIDE( [Total Lines Accepted], [Total Lines Suggested], 0 )
⚠️ Acceptance Lines Rate (%) = Total Lines Accepted ÷ Total Lines Suggested. Total Lines Accepted is an estimate (Lines Suggested × code acceptance rate) — the GitHub API does not expose a direct “lines accepted” counter.
👤
Active Users
Bar / Column Chart – over time
Note: Two bars per day showing the difference between users who had any Copilot activity vs those who actually received code suggestions.

Total Active Users — anyone with any Copilot activity that day
Total Engaged Users — subset who actually received at least one code suggestion

The small gap between the bars represents users who had chat or agent activity but received no code completions.
AxisField / Measure
X-axis (date)vGitHub_MetricUsers[FilterDate]
Y-axis series 1Total Active Users (all users with any Copilot activity)
Y-axis series 2Total Engaged Users (subset with suggestions)
Total Active Users
DISTINCTCOUNT('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[UserLogin])
Total Engaged Users
CALCULATE( DISTINCTCOUNT('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[UserLogin]), 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[CodeGenerationCount] > 0 )
📝
Total Code Lines Suggestions and Acceptances
Area Line Chart – over time
Note: Shows the volume of lines of code that Copilot suggested vs the estimated number that users accepted, over time. The gap between the two areas shows how many suggested lines were dismissed or ignored.
AxisField / Measure
X-axis (date)vGitHub_MetricUsers[FilterDate]
Y-axis series 1 (larger)Total Lines Suggested
Y-axis series 2 (smaller)Total Lines Accepted
Total Lines Suggested
VAR HasAnyRows = NOT ISEMPTY(CALCULATETABLE('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) VAR Result = CALCULATE( SUM('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[LocSuggestedToAdd]), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[assigneeLogin]))), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[teamName]))), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE])))) RETURN IF(HasAnyRows, COALESCE(Result, 0), BLANK())
Total Lines Accepted (estimated)
VAR HasAnyRows = NOT ISEMPTY(CALCULATETABLE('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) VAR ValidMetrics = CALCULATETABLE( 'vGitHub_MetricUsers', KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[assigneeLogin]))), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[teamName]))), KEEPFILTERS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE] <> BLANK()) ) VAR TotalSuggested = SUMX(ValidMetrics, 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[LocSuggestedToAdd]) VAR TotalAccCount = SUMX(ValidMetrics, 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[CodeAcceptanceCount]) VAR TotalGenCount = SUMX(ValidMetrics, 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[CodeGenerationCount]) VAR FinalResult = ROUND(DIVIDE(TotalSuggested * TotalAccCount, TotalGenCount, 0), 0) RETURN IF(HasAnyRows, COALESCE(FinalResult, 0), BLANK())
⚠️ Total Lines Accepted is computed as ROUND((Lines Suggested × Accepted Count) / Generated Count, 0), restricted to licensed users with a valid team assignment and IDE. The GitHub API does not expose a direct “lines accepted” counter.
💡
Total Code Suggestions and Acceptance
Area Line Chart – over time
Note: Similar to the chart above but counts individual suggestions (not lines). Each "suggestion" is one Copilot completion pop-up shown to a user. Each "acceptance" is when the user pressed Tab (or equivalent) to accept it.
AxisField / Measure
X-axis (date)vGitHub_MetricUsers[FilterDate]
Y-axis series 1 (larger)Total Suggestions
Y-axis series 2 (smaller)Total Acceptances
Total Suggestions
VAR HasAnyRows = NOT ISEMPTY(CALCULATETABLE('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) VAR ValidMetrics = CALCULATETABLE( 'vGitHub_MetricUsers', KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[assigneeLogin]))), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[teamName]))), KEEPFILTERS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE] <> BLANK()) ) VAR Result = SUMX(ValidMetrics, 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[CodeGenerationCount]) RETURN IF(HasAnyRows, COALESCE(Result, 0), BLANK())
Total Acceptances
VAR HasAnyRows = NOT ISEMPTY(CALCULATETABLE('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) VAR ValidMetrics = CALCULATETABLE( 'vGitHub_MetricUsers', KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[assigneeLogin]))), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[teamName]))), KEEPFILTERS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE] <> BLANK()) ) VAR Result = SUMX(ValidMetrics, 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[CodeAcceptanceCount]) RETURN IF(HasAnyRows, COALESCE(Result, 0), BLANK())
🍩 Donut Charts
📊
Language
Donut Chart – Percentage of sessions per Language
Note: Shows which programming languages users were working in when Copilot was active. Each slice is one language, and the slices add up to 100% of all Copilot sessions.

Example: If Python is 15%, it means 15% of all Copilot sessions took place in a Python file.
AxisField / Measure
Legend (slices)vGitHub_MetricUsers[Language_Main]
Values (slice size)Language Chart
TooltipLanguage Toolkit
⚠️ Language_Main is a calculated column that picks the first non-blank value from Language1 → Language2 → Language3, ensuring every session row has a language assigned.
Language Chart
VAR TotalRows = CALCULATE( COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'), ALL('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main]), NOT ISBLANK('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main]) ) VAR CurrentRows = COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers') RETURN IF( ISBLANK(CurrentRows) || CurrentRows = 0 || ISBLANK(TotalRows) || TotalRows = 0, BLANK(), VAR Scale = 10000 VAR CurrentLang = SELECTEDVALUE('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main]) VAR CurrentScaled = DIVIDE(CurrentRows * Scale, TotalRows, 0) VAR CurrentFloor = TRUNC(CurrentScaled) VAR CurrentRemainder = CurrentScaled - CurrentFloor VAR AllLangs = FILTER( CALCULATETABLE( ADDCOLUMNS( VALUES('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main]), "@Rows", CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers')), "@Floor", TRUNC(DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) * Scale, TotalRows, 0)), "@Rem", DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) * Scale, TotalRows, 0) - TRUNC(DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) * Scale, TotalRows, 0)) ), ALL('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main]), NOT ISBLANK('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main]) ), [@Rows] > 0 ) VAR TotalFloor = SUMX(AllLangs, [@Floor]) VAR LeftOver = Scale - TotalFloor VAR HigherRemainder = COUNTROWS(FILTER(AllLangs, [@Rem] > CurrentRemainder)) VAR TiesBefore = COUNTROWS(FILTER(AllLangs, [@Rem] = CurrentRemainder && 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main] < CurrentLang )) VAR MyRank = HigherRemainder + TiesBefore + 1 VAR GetsBonus = IF(MyRank <= LeftOver, 1, 0) RETURN DIVIDE(CurrentFloor + GetsBonus, Scale, 0) )
Language Toolkit
Tooltip — shows session share alongside user share for each language slice.
VAR SessionPct = DIVIDE( COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'), CALCULATE( COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'), ALL('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main]) ), 0 ) VAR EngagedInLang = CALCULATE( DISTINCTCOUNT('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[UserLogin]), 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[CodeGenerationCount] > 0 ) VAR TotalEngaged = CALCULATE( DISTINCTCOUNT('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[UserLogin]), 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[CodeGenerationCount] > 0, ALL('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main]) ) VAR UserPct = DIVIDE(EngagedInLang, TotalEngaged, 0) RETURN FORMAT(SessionPct, "0.00%") & " (" & FORMAT(UserPct, "0.00%") & ")"
⚠️ Percentages always sum to exactly 100% using the Largest Remainder Method (scale = 10,000). Language Toolkit tooltip shows session % (Language Chart) alongside user % (engaged users for this language ÷ total engaged users).
💻
Editor
Donut Chart – Percentage of sessions per IDE
Note: Shows which code editors (IDEs) users were working in when Copilot was active. Each slice is one editor, and the slices add up to 100% of all Copilot sessions.

Example: If vscode is 79.6%, it means nearly 80% of all Copilot sessions happened inside VS Code.
AxisField / Measure
Legend (slices)vGitHub_MetricUsers[IDE]
Values (slice size)IDE Chart
TooltipIDE Toolkit
IDE Chart
VAR TotalRows = CALCULATE( COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'), ALL('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE]), NOT ISBLANK('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE]) ) VAR CurrentRows = COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers') RETURN IF( ISBLANK(CurrentRows) || CurrentRows = 0 || ISBLANK(TotalRows) || TotalRows = 0, BLANK(), VAR Scale = 10000 VAR CurrentIDE = SELECTEDVALUE('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE]) VAR CurrentScaled = DIVIDE(CurrentRows * Scale, TotalRows, 0) VAR CurrentFloor = TRUNC(CurrentScaled) VAR CurrentRemainder = CurrentScaled - CurrentFloor VAR AllIDEs = FILTER( CALCULATETABLE( ADDCOLUMNS( VALUES('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE]), "@Rows", CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers')), "@Floor", TRUNC(DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) * Scale, TotalRows, 0)), "@Rem", DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) * Scale, TotalRows, 0) - TRUNC(DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) * Scale, TotalRows, 0)) ), ALL('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE]), NOT ISBLANK('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE]) ), [@Rows] > 0 ) VAR TotalFloor = SUMX(AllIDEs, [@Floor]) VAR LeftOver = Scale - TotalFloor VAR HigherRemainder = COUNTROWS(FILTER(AllIDEs, [@Rem] > CurrentRemainder)) VAR TiesBefore = COUNTROWS(FILTER(AllIDEs, [@Rem] = CurrentRemainder && 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE] < CurrentIDE )) VAR MyRank = HigherRemainder + TiesBefore + 1 VAR GetsBonus = IF(MyRank <= LeftOver, 1, 0) RETURN DIVIDE(CurrentFloor + GetsBonus, Scale, 0) )
IDE Toolkit
Tooltip — shows session share alongside user share for each IDE slice.
VAR SessionPct = DIVIDE( COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'), CALCULATE( COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'), ALL('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE]) ), 0 ) VAR EngagedInIDE = CALCULATE( DISTINCTCOUNT('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[UserLogin]), 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[CodeGenerationCount] > 0 ) VAR TotalEngaged = CALCULATE( DISTINCTCOUNT('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[UserLogin]), 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[CodeGenerationCount] > 0, ALL('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE]) ) VAR UserPct = DIVIDE(EngagedInIDE, TotalEngaged, 0) RETURN FORMAT(SessionPct, "0.00%") & " (" & FORMAT(UserPct, "0.00%") & ")"
⚠️ Percentages always sum to exactly 100% using the Largest Remainder Method (scale = 10,000). IDE Toolkit tooltip shows session % (IDE Chart) alongside user % (engaged users for this IDE ÷ total engaged users).
⚙️ Supporting Measures & Calculated Columns
⚙️
Behind-the-Scenes Measures & Columns
Used by other measures or slicers — not directly shown as visuals
Note: These are helper calculations used internally by the dashboard. You won't see them as standalone visuals, but they power the slicers, dynamic titles, and team filtering.
CurrentDateRangeMessage
Displays the selected date range as text at the bottom of the filter panel.
VAR MinMetrics = CALCULATE( MIN('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[FilterDate]) ) VAR MaxMetrics = CALCULATE( MAX('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[FilterDate]) ) VAR IsSlicingByTeam = ISFILTERED('DimSeat'[teamSlug]) || ISFILTERED('DimSeat'[teamName]) VAR FinalMin = DATE(YEAR(MinMetrics), MONTH(MinMetrics), DAY(MinMetrics)) VAR FinalMax = DATE(YEAR(MaxMetrics), MONTH(MaxMetrics), DAY(MaxMetrics)) VAR SelectedTeam = IF(IsSlicingByTeam, " | Team: " & CONCATENATEX(VALUES('DimSeat'[teamName]), 'DimSeat'[teamName], ", "), "") RETURN IF( ISBLANK(MinMetrics), "🚀 Current Timeframe: No Data Available", "🚀 Current Timeframe: Data spans from " & FORMAT(FinalMin, "MMMM dd, yyyy") & " to " & FORMAT(FinalMax, "MMMM dd, yyyy") & SelectedTeam )
Chat Engaged Users
Distinct users who used Copilot Chat at least once in the period.
CALCULATE( DISTINCTCOUNT('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[UserLogin]), 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[UsedChat] = "1" )
Avg User Acceptance Rate (%)
Simple unweighted average of per-user acceptance rate. Differs from Acceptance Rate (%) which is a weighted aggregate.
DIVIDE( AVERAGE('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[AcceptanceRatePct]), 100, 0 )
⚠️ AcceptanceRatePct is stored as a whole number (e.g. 20 = 20%), so dividing by 100 normalises it to a percentage. This is an unweighted mean — every user session row counts equally regardless of suggestion volume.
Calculated Columns (added to vGitHub_MetricUsers)
ColumnLogicPurpose
Language_Main COALESCE([Language1], [Language2], [Language3]) First non-blank language per session — used as the single language field for all Language visuals and slicers.
Feature_Main COALESCE([Feature1_Name], [Feature2_Name], [Feature3_Name], [Feature4_Name]) First non-blank Copilot feature used in the session.
Model_Main COALESCE([Model1], [Model2], [Model3]) First non-blank AI model used in the session.
FilterDate Parsed from [MetricDate] string → DateTime Enables date slicers and time-based filtering across all charts.
🔧 Filters & Slicers (how to explore the data)
🔧
Page-Level Slicers
Filters — affect ALL visuals on the page
Note: These controls narrow down every chart and number on the page at once. For example, selecting "python" in the Language filter will update all three donut charts and the table to show only Python-related rows.
SlicerFieldWhat it filters
TeamDimSeat[teamName]Limits all metrics to users belonging to a specific GitHub team. Uses the Many-to-Many join between users and team memberships.
IDEvGitHub_MetricUsers[IDE]Filters by coding editor (e.g. vscode, visualstudio, intellij).
LanguagevGitHub_MetricUsers[Language_Main]Filters by the primary programming language used in each session.
Time IntervalTime Interval tableSwitches the date grouping (Daily / Weekly / Monthly) for time-based charts.
Date RangevGitHub_MetricUsers[FilterDate]Limits data to a specific date window using a between-date slicer.
📌 Metric Card
🌍
Number of Languages
Card Visual
Note: The total count of distinct programming languages that had Copilot activity in the selected date range and filters. Each language is counted once regardless of how many users or sessions used it. Blank or empty language values are excluded.
Total Languages
CALCULATE( DISTINCTCOUNT('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main]), KEEPFILTERS( FILTER( ALLSELECTED('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main]), VAR FirstChar = LEFT('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main], 1) RETURN ((FirstChar >= "a" && FirstChar <= "z") || (FirstChar >= "A" && FirstChar <= "Z") || (FirstChar >= "0" && FirstChar <= "9")) && 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main] <> "others" ) ) )
⚠️ Uses KEEPFILTERS with ALLSELECTED to count only languages whose first character is alphanumeric (a–z, A–Z, 0–9) and which are not the literal string “others”. Blank values are automatically excluded. Returns the count of distinct valid languages in the current filter context. In production data this typically returns 400–500+ distinct languages.
📍
Current Timeframe Message
Card Visual — dynamic text label
Note: A dynamic text label shown at the bottom of the filter panel that tells you exactly what date window and team (if any) the page is currently showing. It updates automatically whenever you change the Date Range or Team slicer.
CurrentDateRangeMessage
VAR MinMetrics = CALCULATE( MIN('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[FilterDate]) ) VAR MaxMetrics = CALCULATE( MAX('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[FilterDate]) ) VAR IsSlicingByTeam = ISFILTERED('DimSeat'[teamSlug]) || ISFILTERED('DimSeat'[teamName]) VAR FinalMin = DATE(YEAR(MinMetrics), MONTH(MinMetrics), DAY(MinMetrics)) VAR FinalMax = DATE(YEAR(MaxMetrics), MONTH(MaxMetrics), DAY(MaxMetrics)) VAR SelectedTeam = IF(IsSlicingByTeam, " | Team: " & CONCATENATEX(VALUES('DimSeat'[teamName]), 'DimSeat'[teamName], ", "), "") RETURN IF( ISBLANK(MinMetrics), "🚀 Current Timeframe: No Data Available", "🚀 Current Timeframe: Data spans from " & FORMAT(FinalMin, "MMMM dd, yyyy") & " to " & FORMAT(FinalMax, "MMMM dd, yyyy") & SelectedTeam )
🍩 Donut Charts — Top 5 Languages
✅
Top 5 Languages by Accepted Suggestions
Donut Chart — Top N filter applied
Note: Shows the 5 languages where users accepted the most Copilot suggestions (prompts). Slice size = total accepted suggestion count for that language. The bigger the slice, the more Copilot completions users kept in that language.
AxisField / Measure
Legend (slices)vGitHub_MetricUsers[Language_Main]
Values (slice size)Total Acceptances
Top N filterTop 5 by Total Acceptances
Total Acceptances
VAR HasAnyRows = NOT ISEMPTY(CALCULATETABLE('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) VAR ValidMetrics = CALCULATETABLE( 'vGitHub_MetricUsers', KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[assigneeLogin]))), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[teamName]))), KEEPFILTERS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE] <> BLANK()) ) VAR Result = SUMX(ValidMetrics, 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[CodeAcceptanceCount]) RETURN IF(HasAnyRows, COALESCE(Result, 0), BLANK())
⚠️ Total Suggestions and Total Acceptances are restricted to licensed users (DimSeat) with a valid team assignment and IDE. Unfiltered rows (no seat, no team, blank IDE) are excluded so that the counts match what the dashboard visuals display. CodeGenerationCount = suggestions shown; CodeAcceptanceCount = suggestions accepted (Tab key or equivalent).
📊
Acceptance Rate (by count) for Top 5 Languages
Donut Chart — Top N filter applied
Note: Shows the acceptance rate (suggestions accepted ÷ suggestions shown) for the 5 languages with the highest acceptance rate. A higher rate means users in that language kept a larger proportion of what Copilot suggested.
AxisField / Measure
Legend (slices)vGitHub_MetricUsers[Language_Main]
Values (slice size)Acceptance Rate (%)
Top N filterTop 5 by Acceptance Rate (%)
Acceptance Rate (%)
DIVIDE( [Total Acceptances], [Total Suggestions], 0 )
⚠️ This is a prompt-level rate: out of every suggestion bubble Copilot showed, what fraction did the user keep? Languages with very few sessions can show 100% rates.
📝
Acceptance Rate (by code lines) for Top 5 Languages
Donut Chart — Top N filter applied
Note: Similar to the centre chart but measures acceptance at the line-of-code level. Uses Total Lines Accepted (estimated) divided by Total Lines Suggested. A higher rate means more suggested lines were accepted vs dismissed in that language.
AxisField / Measure
Legend (slices)vGitHub_MetricUsers[Language_Main]
Values (slice size)Acceptance Lines Rate (%)
Top N filterTop 5 by Acceptance Lines Rate (%)
Acceptance Lines Rate (%)
DIVIDE( [Total Lines Accepted], [Total Lines Suggested], 0 )
⚠️ Total Lines Accepted is an estimate: Lines Suggested × code acceptance rate. The raw LocAdded column is excluded as it captures all editor additions (not just Copilot-accepted lines). This aligns the line-level rate with the volume charts.
📋 Language Breakdown Table
📋
Language Breakdown Table
Matrix / Table Visual — one row per Language
Note: A full breakdown of every language with Copilot activity. Each row is one language. The columns let you compare raw volume (how many suggestions were made and accepted) alongside rate metrics (what percentage were accepted). Click a column header to sort. Use the Language slicer on the left to drill into a single language.
ColumnMeasure / FieldWhat it shows
Language NamevGitHub_MetricUsers[Language_Main]The primary programming language for that group of sessions.
Accepted PromptsTotal AcceptancesNumber of Copilot suggestion prompts the user accepted (pressed Tab / accepted) across all sessions in this language.
Suggested PromptsTotal SuggestionsTotal number of Copilot suggestion prompts shown to users in this language.
Total Lines AcceptedTotal Lines AcceptedEstimated lines of code accepted. Calculated as Lines Suggested × Acceptance Rate (see note below).
Total Lines SuggestedTotal Lines SuggestedSum of LocSuggestedToAdd — the raw line count Copilot suggested across all sessions.
Acceptance Rate (%)Acceptance Rate (%)Prompt-level acceptance rate: Accepted Prompts ÷ Suggested Prompts.
Acceptance Lines Rate (%)Acceptance Lines Rate (%)Line-level acceptance rate: Total Lines Accepted (estimated) ÷ Total Lines Suggested.
⚙️ Table Column Measures — DAX Detail
📝
Suggestions & Acceptances (Prompt-level)
Volume measures
Note: These two measures count raw suggestion events — how many times Copilot offered a completion, and how many times the user accepted it. They are the foundation for the Acceptance Rate (%).
Total Suggestions
VAR HasAnyRows = NOT ISEMPTY(CALCULATETABLE('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) VAR ValidMetrics = CALCULATETABLE( 'vGitHub_MetricUsers', KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[assigneeLogin]))), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[teamName]))), KEEPFILTERS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE] <> BLANK()) ) VAR Result = SUMX(ValidMetrics, 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[CodeGenerationCount]) RETURN IF(HasAnyRows, COALESCE(Result, 0), BLANK())
Total Acceptances
VAR HasAnyRows = NOT ISEMPTY(CALCULATETABLE('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) VAR ValidMetrics = CALCULATETABLE( 'vGitHub_MetricUsers', KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[assigneeLogin]))), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[teamName]))), KEEPFILTERS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE] <> BLANK()) ) VAR Result = SUMX(ValidMetrics, 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[CodeAcceptanceCount]) RETURN IF(HasAnyRows, COALESCE(Result, 0), BLANK())
Acceptance Rate (%)
DIVIDE( [Total Acceptances], [Total Suggestions], 0 )
📏
Lines Suggested & Accepted (Line-level)
Volume measures
Note: These measure the volume of lines of code involved in Copilot suggestions. Total Lines Suggested is filtered to licensed users with a valid team (DimSeat) and IDE, matching the same row scope as Total Suggestions and Total Acceptances. Total Lines Accepted uses ROUND(DIVIDE(Suggested × AcceptedCount, GeneratedCount, 0), 0) for precision — the GitHub API does not expose a direct lines-accepted counter.
Total Lines Suggested
VAR HasAnyRows = NOT ISEMPTY(CALCULATETABLE('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) VAR Result = CALCULATE( SUM('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[LocSuggestedToAdd]), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[assigneeLogin]))), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[teamName]))), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE])))) RETURN IF(HasAnyRows, COALESCE(Result, 0), BLANK())
Total Lines Accepted (estimated)
VAR HasAnyRows = NOT ISEMPTY(CALCULATETABLE('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) VAR ValidMetrics = CALCULATETABLE( 'vGitHub_MetricUsers', KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[assigneeLogin]))), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[teamName]))), KEEPFILTERS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE] <> BLANK()) ) VAR TotalSuggested = SUMX(ValidMetrics, 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[LocSuggestedToAdd]) VAR TotalAccCount = SUMX(ValidMetrics, 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[CodeAcceptanceCount]) VAR TotalGenCount = SUMX(ValidMetrics, 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[CodeGenerationCount]) VAR FinalResult = ROUND(DIVIDE(TotalSuggested * TotalAccCount, TotalGenCount, 0), 0) RETURN IF(HasAnyRows, COALESCE(FinalResult, 0), BLANK())
⚠️ Total Lines Accepted is an estimate: Lines Suggested × Acceptance Rate. The GitHub API does not expose a direct "lines accepted" counter. The raw LocAdded column captures ALL editor additions, not just Copilot-accepted lines, so it cannot be used directly.
Acceptance Lines Rate (%)
DIVIDE( [Total Lines Accepted], [Total Lines Suggested], 0 )
⚠️ The line-level acceptance rate references the same Total Lines Accepted estimate above, keeping the rate consistent with the volume charts.

👤
Total Seats
Card Visual
Note: The total number of unique GitHub users who appear in the Copilot data for the selected period. Each person is counted once, no matter how many days or sessions they had.
Total Users
DISTINCTCOUNT('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[UserLogin])
✅
Active Seats
Card Visual
Note: Users who have been actively using Copilot within the last 90 days from today. This is the standard GitHub definition of an "active seat" — if someone hasn't used Copilot in over 3 months, they don't count.
Active Seats
VAR CutoffDate = TODAY() - 90 RETURN COUNTROWS( FILTER( VALUES('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[UserLogin]), NOT ISBLANK('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[UserLogin]) && CALCULATE( MAXX( 'vGitHub_MetricUsers', DATEVALUE(LEFT('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[LastActivityAt], 10)) ) ) >= CutoffDate ) )
⚠️ For each user, this checks their most recent activity date. If it's within 90 days of today, they count as active.
📈
Adoption Rate
Card Visual
Note: Out of all users who have a Copilot licence, what percentage are actually using it actively?
Adoption Rate
DIVIDE([Active Seats], [Total Users])
⚠️ Formula: Active Seats ÷ Total Seats. Example: 19,527 active ÷ 19,586 total = 99.7%.
👤 User Details
📋
User Details Table
Table Visual — one row per user
Note: A user-level table showing the most recent activity attributes for each GitHub user. Use it alongside the User Login slicer to drill into a specific person, or scroll through it to spot patterns across users — e.g. which users are on older IDE versions or which languages dominate.
ColumnSource FieldWhat it shows
NameDimUser[name]Display name of the GitHub user (friendlier than the raw login).
User LoginvGitHub_MetricUsers[UserLogin]Raw GitHub username — the join key between DimUser and the metrics table.
TeamDimSeat[teamName]GitHub team the user belongs to.
License TypeDimSeat[licenseType]Type of Copilot licence assigned (e.g. business, enterprise).
LanguagevGitHub_MetricUsers[Language_Main]Primary programming language used in the session.
IDEvGitHub_MetricUsers[IDE]Code editor the user was working in.
ModelvGitHub_MetricUsers[Model_Main]Primary AI model used in the session.
FeaturevGitHub_MetricUsers[Feature_Main]Primary Copilot feature used (e.g. code_completion, chat_panel_agent_mode).
⚠️ This table is connected to DimUser via the Many-to-Many relationship on UserLogin ↔ DimUser[login]. Using DimUser[name] instead of the raw UserLogin gives a human-readable name and ensures the slicer works correctly with bidirectional cross-filtering.
📊 Line / Area Charts
📝
Total Code Lines Suggestions and Acceptances
Area Line Chart – over time
Note: Shows the volume of lines of code that Copilot suggested vs the estimated number that users accepted, over time. The gap between the two areas shows how many suggested lines were dismissed or ignored.
AxisField / Measure
X-axis (date)vGitHub_MetricUsers[FilterDate]
Y-axis series 1 (larger)Total Lines Suggested
Y-axis series 2 (smaller)Total Lines Accepted
Total Lines Suggested
VAR HasAnyRows = NOT ISEMPTY(CALCULATETABLE('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) VAR Result = CALCULATE( SUM('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[LocSuggestedToAdd]), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[assigneeLogin]))), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[teamName]))), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE])))) RETURN IF(HasAnyRows, COALESCE(Result, 0), BLANK())
Total Lines Accepted (estimated)
VAR HasAnyRows = NOT ISEMPTY(CALCULATETABLE('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) VAR ValidMetrics = CALCULATETABLE( 'vGitHub_MetricUsers', KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[assigneeLogin]))), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[teamName]))), KEEPFILTERS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE] <> BLANK()) ) VAR TotalSuggested = SUMX(ValidMetrics, 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[LocSuggestedToAdd]) VAR TotalAccCount = SUMX(ValidMetrics, 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[CodeAcceptanceCount]) VAR TotalGenCount = SUMX(ValidMetrics, 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[CodeGenerationCount]) VAR FinalResult = ROUND(DIVIDE(TotalSuggested * TotalAccCount, TotalGenCount, 0), 0) RETURN IF(HasAnyRows, COALESCE(FinalResult, 0), BLANK())
⚠️ Total Lines Accepted is computed as ROUND((Lines Suggested × Accepted Count) / Generated Count, 0), restricted to licensed users with a valid team assignment and IDE. The GitHub API does not expose a direct “lines accepted” counter.
💡
Total Code Suggestions and Acceptance
Area Line Chart – over time
Note: Counts individual suggestions (not lines). Each "suggestion" is one Copilot completion pop-up shown to a user. Each "acceptance" is when the user pressed Tab (or equivalent) to accept it.
AxisField / Measure
X-axis (date)vGitHub_MetricUsers[FilterDate]
Y-axis series 1 (larger)Total Suggestions
Y-axis series 2 (smaller)Total Acceptances
Total Suggestions
VAR HasAnyRows = NOT ISEMPTY(CALCULATETABLE('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) VAR ValidMetrics = CALCULATETABLE( 'vGitHub_MetricUsers', KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[assigneeLogin]))), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[teamName]))), KEEPFILTERS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE] <> BLANK()) ) VAR Result = SUMX(ValidMetrics, 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[CodeGenerationCount]) RETURN IF(HasAnyRows, COALESCE(Result, 0), BLANK())
Total Acceptances
VAR HasAnyRows = NOT ISEMPTY(CALCULATETABLE('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) VAR ValidMetrics = CALCULATETABLE( 'vGitHub_MetricUsers', KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[assigneeLogin]))), KEEPFILTERS(NOT(ISBLANK('DimSeat'[teamName]))), KEEPFILTERS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE] <> BLANK()) ) VAR Result = SUMX(ValidMetrics, 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[CodeAcceptanceCount]) RETURN IF(HasAnyRows, COALESCE(Result, 0), BLANK())
🍩 Donut Charts
📊
Language
Donut Chart – Percentage of active users per Language
Note: Shows which programming languages users were working in when Copilot was active. Each slice is one language, and the slices add up to 100% of all Copilot sessions.
AxisField / Measure
Legend (slices)vGitHub_MetricUsers[Language_Main]
Values (slice size)Language Chart
Language Chart
VAR TotalRows = CALCULATE( COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'), ALL('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main]), NOT ISBLANK('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main]) ) VAR CurrentRows = COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers') RETURN IF( ISBLANK(CurrentRows) || CurrentRows = 0 || ISBLANK(TotalRows) || TotalRows = 0, BLANK(), VAR Scale = 10000 VAR CurrentLang = SELECTEDVALUE('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main]) VAR CurrentScaled = DIVIDE(CurrentRows * Scale, TotalRows, 0) VAR CurrentFloor = TRUNC(CurrentScaled) VAR CurrentRemainder = CurrentScaled - CurrentFloor VAR AllLangs = FILTER( CALCULATETABLE( ADDCOLUMNS( VALUES('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main]), "@Rows", CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers')), "@Floor", TRUNC(DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) * Scale, TotalRows, 0)), "@Rem", DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) * Scale, TotalRows, 0) - TRUNC(DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) * Scale, TotalRows, 0)) ), ALL('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main]), NOT ISBLANK('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main]) ), [@Rows] > 0 ) VAR TotalFloor = SUMX(AllLangs, [@Floor]) VAR LeftOver = Scale - TotalFloor VAR HigherRemainder = COUNTROWS(FILTER(AllLangs, [@Rem] > CurrentRemainder)) VAR TiesBefore = COUNTROWS(FILTER(AllLangs, [@Rem] = CurrentRemainder && 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Language_Main] < CurrentLang )) VAR MyRank = HigherRemainder + TiesBefore + 1 VAR GetsBonus = IF(MyRank <= LeftOver, 1, 0) RETURN DIVIDE(CurrentFloor + GetsBonus, Scale, 0) )
⚠️ Percentages always sum to exactly 100% using the Largest Remainder Method (scale = 10,000).
💻
Editor
Donut Chart – Percentage of active users per Editor
Note: Shows which code editors (IDEs) users were working in when Copilot was active. Each slice is one editor, summing to 100% of all sessions.
AxisField / Measure
Legend (slices)vGitHub_MetricUsers[IDE]
Values (slice size)IDE Chart
IDE Chart
VAR TotalRows = CALCULATE( COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'), ALL('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE]), NOT ISBLANK('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE]) ) VAR CurrentRows = COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers') RETURN IF( ISBLANK(CurrentRows) || CurrentRows = 0 || ISBLANK(TotalRows) || TotalRows = 0, BLANK(), VAR Scale = 10000 VAR CurrentIDE = SELECTEDVALUE('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE]) VAR CurrentScaled = DIVIDE(CurrentRows * Scale, TotalRows, 0) VAR CurrentFloor = TRUNC(CurrentScaled) VAR CurrentRemainder = CurrentScaled - CurrentFloor VAR AllIDEs = FILTER( CALCULATETABLE( ADDCOLUMNS( VALUES('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE]), "@Rows", CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers')), "@Floor", TRUNC(DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) * Scale, TotalRows, 0)), "@Rem", DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) * Scale, TotalRows, 0) - TRUNC(DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers')) * Scale, TotalRows, 0)) ), ALL('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE]), NOT ISBLANK('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE]) ), [@Rows] > 0 ) VAR TotalFloor = SUMX(AllIDEs, [@Floor]) VAR LeftOver = Scale - TotalFloor VAR HigherRemainder = COUNTROWS(FILTER(AllIDEs, [@Rem] > CurrentRemainder)) VAR TiesBefore = COUNTROWS(FILTER(AllIDEs, [@Rem] = CurrentRemainder && 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[IDE] < CurrentIDE )) VAR MyRank = HigherRemainder + TiesBefore + 1 VAR GetsBonus = IF(MyRank <= LeftOver, 1, 0) RETURN DIVIDE(CurrentFloor + GetsBonus, Scale, 0) )
⚠️ Percentages always sum to exactly 100% using the Largest Remainder Method (scale = 10,000).
📊 Chat Model Usage Charts

Chat Model Usage
Donut Chart — % share per model
Note: Shows the distribution of AI models used across all chat sessions in the selected period. Each slice is one model group (Top 5 + “Other models”), and all slices add up to 100%.
AxisField / Measure
Legend (slices)vGitHub_MetricUsers[Model Grouping]
Values (slice size)Chart Percentage of Model Usage
Chart Percentage of Model Usage
DIVIDE( COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'), CALCULATE( COUNTROWS('vGitHub_MetricUsers'), ALL('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Model Grouping]) ), 0 )
⚠️ Percentages sum to exactly 100%. The ALL() on Model Grouping removes the per-slice filter so the denominator is always the full session count.
📊
Model Usage Per Chat Mode
Stacked Bar Chart — interactions by model & mode
Note: Shows the most frequently used models for user-initiated chat requests, broken down by chat mode (Agent, Ask, Custom, Edit, Inline, Plan). Each bar is a model group; each coloured segment within the bar is a chat mode.
AxisField / Measure
X-axis (bars)vGitHub_MetricUsers[Model Grouping]
Y-axis (height)Chat Interactions by Model (Filtered)
Legend (segments)vGitHub_MetricUsers[Chat Mode]
SortX-axis descending by Chat Interactions by Model (Filtered)
Chat Interactions by Model (Filtered)
SUMX( SUMMARIZE( 'vGitHub_MetricUsers', 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[UserLogin], 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[FilterDate], 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Model Grouping], 'vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Model1_Feature], "Ints", MAX('vGitHub_MetricUsers'[Model1_Interactions]) ), [Ints] )
⚠️ The SUMMARIZE + SUMX pattern deduplicates interactions per user/date/model/feature before summing, preventing double-counting.
